title: Microsoft Bookings pages and enforced CSP
summary: Book APES meetings and appointments from inside the app, and the security policy now blocks content from untrusted sites.
changes: New Bookings pages for APES, APES Shelter and Rescue and APES Pet Care Clinic, each showing the Microsoft Bookings form.
Each Bookings page has a Schedule online button that opens Microsoft Bookings in a new tab if the form does not load.
Bookings is in the public menu, the signed-in Support menu and Ctrl K search.
The Content Security Policy is now enforced instead of report-only.
Email template previews and the description editor are allowed by the policy.
The Staff guide and Admin guide menu items now show their icons.
version_rationale: Patch within the 0.51 milestone: adds three static pages and turns on an existing security setting.
validation: New feature test for the three Bookings pages, the fallback link, the menus and unknown pages.
Security header tests updated for enforcement.
Clean report-only run on the live site and local signed-in pages before enforcing.
known_limitations: Bookings made on Microsoft Bookings are not copied into the app.
rollback: Set CSP_ENFORCE=false on the app to return to report-only without a release, or redeploy the previous release package to remove the Bookings pages. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.51.2 Beta, issue #488 under epic #487, pull request #631.
